hero.title: A clearer view of public declarations.

comparison.empty: No income or asset rows were found in this snapshot.
comparison.incomeExplanation: Average annual income: {average} ({total} divided by {years} reported years).
comparison.note: The pie shows each amount as a share of the combined comparison. It is an indicator, not a measure of annual spending or personal wealth.

assets.title: Assets, by section
assets.empty: No asset rows were found in this snapshot.

snapshotMeaning.title: What this snapshot means
snapshotMeaning.counts: Counts are limited to the latest successful snapshot shared across the curated tables.
snapshotMeaning.amounts: Amounts preserve the normalized numeric values produced by the ingestion pipeline. They are presented as indicators, not as a substitute for the source declarations.

about.title: A small window into a public dataset.
paragraphs: This dashboard is built from the HATVP open-data pipeline. The pipeline preserves raw source files, normalizes records, checks quality, and publishes four curated BigQuery tables.
The overview intentionally exposes aggregates only. Personal contact details and raw declaration rows are not part of this public API.
about.sourcePrefix: For the authoritative source and the full declaration context, use the official HATVP links below.

search.title: Find a declaration by what you know.
search.description: Search the latest public HATVP snapshot by declarant name, declaration type, mandate, organisation, identifier, date, or declared amount.
search.placeholder: Name, mandate, organisation, declaration ID, amount…
search.hint: Search is accent-insensitive and matches partial words. Contact details and addresses are never searched or shown.
search.emptyTitle: Start with a name or keyword
search.emptyDescription: Try a surname such as “Dupont”, a mandate, an organisation, a declaration identifier, or an amount.
search.noResults: Nothing matched “{query}”. Try a shorter name or another public field.
